name: messaging
title: Messaging
blurb: Email and text messages to members, with the member in control: kinds of message each with their own switch (what reaches you), signed one-click unsubscribe, a suppression list fed by bounces and complaints, and the owner's messages to an audience they own with a derived recipient list (never typed), a weekly cap, scheduling, tracked links, replies, and a ledger that makes sending twice impossible. Also a weekly digest and nudges, run hourly. The app hands in its audiences, digest content and phone numbers from code.
